title: mail/main.rs: TLS secretx bytes loaded but dropped, not wired to acceptor
description: mail/src/main.rs lines 80-107: when TLS is configured, the code resolves secretx, calls load_tls_server_config_with_key_bytes, and discards the ServerConfig result. The TLS acceptor is never built or stored. A future contributor adding HTTPS support will need to re-resolve the secretx secret (requiring a second network/vault roundtrip) because the resolved bytes were not retained. The comment says 'not yet active in v1' but leaves no clear path for wiring it in without re-fetching the secret.
